lede: Horn Lake celebrates Christmas at Latimer Lakes Park, where the parks department lights a tree, invites Santa and judges gingerbread houses.
celebrates: Horn Lake Parks and Recreation runs the town's main kids' Christmas event, the Annual Christmas Tree Lighting Festival at Latimer Lakes Park, where the parks office also sits at 5633 Tulane Road. The department's post promises a Santa meet and greet, and its events page adds a Gingerbread House Contest with a registration form and posted rules. The DeSoto County Dream Center on Windchase Drive in Horn Lake runs its own family Christmas days for local families, including Christmas DREAMland on December 5, 2026, which the center aims at underserved DeSoto County families.
lastyear: In 2025 the DeSoto County Dream Center in Horn Lake held a Winter Wonderland day on Saturday, December 6, from 8 am to 5 pm at 6935 Windchase Drive. For a Horn Lake parade record, Discover DeSoto reported in 2023 that the Horn Lake Christmas Parade was canceled for bad weather and families were pointed to the Horn Lake Christmas Tree Lighting at Latimer Lakes Park on December 12 at 6:30 pm instead.
facts: Horn Lake keeps its holiday programming close to the park. The parks department has its office inside Latimer Lakes Park at 5633 Tulane Road, and the same park hosts the tree lighting. faq: Where is the Horn Lake tree lighting held?

The Horn Lake Parks and Recreation department holds its Christmas Tree Lighting Festival at Latimer Lakes Park, 5633 Tulane Road, Horn Lake, MS 38637. The department's own events page lists the festival and a gingerbread house contest that takes place at the tree lighting.
Is there a gingerbread house contest in Horn Lake?

Yes. The parks department lists a Gingerbread House Contest at the Christmas Tree Lighting and posts a registration form and contest rules on its events page. Families who want to enter should read the rules and fill in the form before the festival.
Can kids meet Santa in Horn Lake?

The parks department's post for the Christmas Tree Lighting Festival promises a Santa meet and greet at Latimer Lakes Park. The department does not print an admission price, so call 662-342-3468 if you want to confirm anything before you go.
Does Horn Lake have a Christmas parade?

Horn Lake has held a Christmas parade in past years. In 2023, Discover DeSoto reported that the parade was canceled for bad weather and the tree lighting at Latimer Lakes Park replaced it. We found no 2026 Horn Lake parade on an official page.
